blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. JV Ejercito called for a detailed accounting of the P90-billion allocation for the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Modernization Program, particularly fund releases, obligations, expenditures, and project implementation. During the Senate Committee on Finance’s subpanel hearing on the proposed budget of the Department of National Defense (DND) on Monday, Ejercito asked defense officials which military equipment and systems had been delivered and were already being used by Filipino soldiers. He also asked about the obstacles delaying modernization projects and which capability gaps should be prioritized in the proposed 2027 budget. READ: AFP modernization fund to be […]...
